title: Airflow DAG Run Failures
dataSources: Airflow logs (`airflow:scheduler`, `airflow:task`), Airflow StatsD/OTel metrics, dbt `run_results.json`/`sources.json` (`dbt:run_results`), dbt Cloud API run history, Dagster/Prefect run events.
app: Apache Airflow scheduler/worker logs and StatsD/OTel metrics via HEC; dbt run-results/manifest artifacts and dbt Cloud API via HEC scripted inputs; Dagster/Prefect event logs.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=airflow:scheduler event=dag_run_finished
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(state="failed")) as failures by dag_id
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/runs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Tracks Airflow DAG run outcomes and ranks pipelines by failure rate, the primary signal that a data pipeline has broken.
value: A failed DAG stops data flowing to every downstream table and dashboard; ranking by failure rate points at the pipelines hurting the business most.
implementation: Ship Airflow scheduler logs or emit run events to HEC; schedule every 15 minutes; alert on failures for critical DAGs. Map DAGs to downstream datasets.
visualization: Table by failure rate, timechart of DAG failures, alert.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the scheduled data workflows and tell you the moment one fails, instead of you finding out from a broken report.
